issuing_orgs: National Institute of General Medical Sciences
synopsis: The purpose of the Native American Research Centers for Health (NARCH) Planning Grants program is to support federally recognized American Indian/Alaska Native (AI/AN) Tribes, Tribal colleges and universities, Tribal health programs, or Tribal organizations (collectively, eligible AI/AN Tribal entities) to plan and conduct preparatory work for developing competitive NARCH applications.
title: Native American Research Centers for Health (NARCH) Planning Grants (R34 - Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
